source: Hand-authored approximation of Georgetown, Washington DC, reconstructed from general geographic knowledge. Not OpenStreetMap data; not survey-accurate.
howToEdit: Coordinates are [lat, lon] (WGS84 degrees). oneway: "no", "forward" (traffic runs in the order the points are listed) or "backward". A point shared by two streets is a junction: move it in every street that lists it. Optional per-street "maxspeed" (km/h) overrides the default. Regenerate with: node scripts/georgetownFromSpec.mjs

streets.name: Rock Creek and Potomac Parkway
streets.notes: Two-way wooded valley road on the east bank of Rock Creek. Passes under the K St, Pennsylvania Ave, M St, P St and Q St bridges and runs past Thompson Boat Center at the south edge. No at-grade junctions inside the box (ramps to K St / Whitehurst / Virginia Ave not modelled). Rush-hour one-way operation north of Virginia Ave in reality.

streets.name: Canal Rd NW
streets.notes: Continues M St west below the Georgetown University bluff, beside the canal. Reversible one-way at rush hour in reality; modelled two-way.

streets.name: M St NW (Georgetown)
streets.notes: Main shopping street, two lanes each way. Key Bridge lands on it between 35th and 36th, the Exorcist Steps rise from it at 36th, Pennsylvania Ave forks off at 29th St. Ends at 28th St where the Rock Creek bridge begins.

streets.name: Pennsylvania Ave NW (Georgetown)
streets.notes: Forks south-east off M St at 29th St, passing the Four Seasons, to its own Rock Creek bridge.

streets.name: Water St NW
streets.notes: Waterfront street under the Whitehurst Freeway, continuation of K St west of Wisconsin Ave. Dead-ends at the boathouses and the start of the Capital Crescent Trail just west of Key Bridge (passes under the bridge).

streets.name: K St NW (Georgetown)
streets.notes: Ground-level waterfront street directly under the elevated Whitehurst Freeway; Washington Harbour and Waterfront Park on its river side.

streets.name: Grace St NW
streets.notes: Short street between the canal and Water St, from Wisconsin Ave west to 33rd St.

streets.name: South St NW
streets.notes: Short street between the canal and K St, from Wisconsin Ave east to 31st St (Ritz-Carlton, 3100 South St).

streets.name: Prospect St NW
streets.notes: Narrow street half a block north of M St, from 37th St to Wisconsin Ave. The Exorcist Steps arrive at 36th St.

streets.name: N St NW
streets.notes: Federal rowhouses; steep west of Wisconsin. Dead-ends east of 28th St at the edge of the Rock Creek valley.

streets.name: Dumbarton St NW
streets.notes: Narrow street between N and O St, east of Wisconsin only. Geometry from one source (the other placed it between P and Q St).

streets.name: O St NW
streets.notes: Cobblestones with old streetcar rails over long stretches. West end at the Georgetown University main gate (37th St). Ends east at 27th St by Rose Park.

streets.name: P St NW (Georgetown)
streets.notes: Main east-west residential street with cobble and streetcar-rail sections; crosses Rock Creek to Dupont Circle.

streets.name: Q St NW (Georgetown)
streets.notes: Large houses (Tudor Place, Dumbarton House). Runs from 35th St east to the Dumbarton (Buffalo) Bridge.

streets.name: R St NW
streets.notes: Top of the hill. Dumbarton Oaks, Montrose Park and Oak Hill Cemetery line its north side. Becomes Reservoir Rd west of 35th St; ends east at 28th St.

streets.name: Reservoir Rd NW
streets.notes: Continuation of R St west of 35th St along the north edge of Georgetown University.

streets.name: M St Bridge over Rock Creek
streets.notes: Spans Rock Creek and the parkway between 28th St and the West End.

streets.name: M St NW (West End)
streets.notes: Hotels and offices. One source has it one-way westbound east of 24th St (as in downtown); majority two-way.

streets.name: Pennsylvania Ave Bridge over Rock Creek
streets.notes: 1916 concrete arch bridge just south of the M St bridge.

streets.name: Pennsylvania Ave NW (West End)
streets.notes: Runs ESE from Rock Creek to Washington Circle.

streets.name: Pennsylvania Ave NW (east of Washington Circle)
streets.notes: Continues ESE toward the White House.

streets.name: K St bridge over Rock Creek
streets.notes: Low crossing of Rock Creek and the parkway at the creek mouth. The Whitehurst Freeway runs directly above it and lands at its east end.

streets.name: K St NW (West End)
streets.notes: Six-lane arterial from Rock Creek to Washington Circle. Through lanes drop into the underpass beneath the circle; a ramp joins the circle.

streets.name: K St NW (east of Washington Circle)
streets.notes: Continues east toward downtown after the Washington Circle underpass.

streets.name: P St Bridge over Rock Creek
streets.notes: Crosses Rock Creek and the parkway.

streets.name: P St NW (east of Rock Creek)
streets.notes: Toward Dupont Circle.

streets.name: Dumbarton Bridge (Q St, Buffalo Bridge)
streets.notes: Curved masonry bridge with bronze bison, carrying Q St over Rock Creek and the parkway.

streets.name: Q St NW (east of Rock Creek)
streets.notes: Toward Dupont Circle.

streets.name: I St NW
streets.notes: Foggy Bottom: GWU Hospital and Foggy Bottom-GWU Metro near 23rd St.

streets.name: H St NW
streets.notes: Close to the south edge of the box, GWU campus.

streets.name: L St NW
streets.notes: One source has it one-way eastbound with a bike lane (as downtown); majority two-way.

streets.name: 37th St NW
streets.notes: East edge of the Georgetown University campus; starts at the west end of Prospect St.

streets.name: 36th St NW
streets.notes: No road between M St and Prospect St: that block is the Exorcist Steps.

streets.name: Exorcist Steps
streets.notes: Very steep public stair (about 75-97 steps) from M St up to Prospect St at 36th St. Pedestrians only.

streets.name: 35th St NW
streets.notes: Steep from M St up to N St. R St turns into Reservoir Rd at its junction with 35th. One-way direction unknown (sources split two-way / northbound / southbound), so left two-way; if 34th is run northbound, 35th is the likely southbound partner.

streets.name: 34th St NW
streets.notes: Very steep from M St to Prospect. Francis Scott Key Park at the M St corner, Volta Park at Q St. One-way northbound is a majority guess.

streets.name: 33rd St NW
streets.notes: Crosses the canal on a small bridge between Water St and M St. Steep. One-way southbound is a majority guess.

streets.name: Potomac St NW
streets.notes: Short street; south of M St a pedestrian way continues to the Potomac St canal footbridge.

streets.name: Wisconsin Ave NW
streets.notes: Main north-south shopping street. Climbs about 5-6% from the canal to R St and leans NNW. South end at the K St / Water St junction; crosses the canal on a bridge.

streets.name: 31st St NW
streets.notes: Crosses the canal by bridge; Tudor Place between Q and R St. May be one-way north of M.

streets.name: Thomas Jefferson St NW
streets.notes: South of M only: old warehouses, canal locks and visitor area, over a canal bridge to Washington Harbour.

streets.name: 30th St NW
streets.notes: Crosses the canal near Lock 3. North end at Oak Hill Cemetery / R St. One-way southbound is a majority guess.

streets.name: 29th St NW
streets.notes: Canal bridge near Locks 1-2. One-way northbound is a majority guess.

streets.name: 28th St NW
streets.notes: Slopes down toward the Rock Creek valley on its east side. Ends at R St by Oak Hill Cemetery.

streets.name: 27th St NW (Georgetown)
streets.notes: Short street at the edge of the creek valley beside Rose Park; extent uncertain.

streets.name: 26th St NW
streets.notes: West End side street.

streets.name: 25th St NW
streets.notes: West End side street.

streets.name: 24th St NW
streets.notes: Continues north of M St toward N St (dead-ends in this model).

streets.name: 23rd St NW (south of Washington Circle)
streets.notes: GWU Hospital and Foggy Bottom-GWU Metro near I St.

streets.name: 23rd St NW (north of Washington Circle)
streets.notes: Runs north from Washington Circle toward Sheridan Circle and Massachusetts Ave (beyond Q St, outside this model).

streets.name: 22nd St NW
streets.notes: Just inside the east edge of the box.

streets.name: New Hampshire Ave NW (south of Washington Circle)
streets.notes: Heads SSW toward the Watergate and Kennedy Center.

streets.name: New Hampshire Ave NW (north of Washington Circle)
streets.notes: Diagonal NNE toward Dupont Circle.

streets.name: Francis Scott Key Bridge
streets.notes: Concrete arch bridge to Rosslyn VA. North end lands on M St between 35th and 36th St; passes high over the Whitehurst ramps, the canal, the towpath, Water St and the Potomac. Cut at the box edge.

streets.name: Whitehurst Freeway
streets.notes: Elevated steel viaduct directly above K St / Water St from Rock Creek to about 34th St, then curves NW over the canal. West end simplified to a single junction at M St / Key Bridge (real ramps also serve Canal Rd); east end comes down onto K St just east of Rock Creek.

streets.name: C&O Canal Towpath
streets.notes: Gravel and brick towpath on the south (river) side of the canal, passing under the street bridges. Pedestrians and bikes only; not connected to the road graph.

streets.name: Capital Crescent Trail
streets.notes: Rail-trail starting at the west end of Water St, between the canal and the river.

streets.name: K St NW (Washington Circle underpass)
streets.notes: Through lanes of K St in a short underpass beneath Washington Circle (2 of 3 sources). Below grade: no junction with the ring even though it crosses it in plan.

streets.name: K St NW (Washington Circle west ramp)
streets.notes: Surface lanes from K St up to the circle (west side). Shares its first metres with the underpass portal.

streets.name: K St NW (Washington Circle east ramp)
streets.notes: Surface lanes from the circle (east side) down to K St.

streets.name: Washington Circle
streets.notes: Roundabout ring, closed loop (first point = last point), points run counter-clockwise in the direction of traffic. Centre 38.90250,-77.05050, radius 55 m. Spokes: 23rd St north and south, New Hampshire Ave NNE and SSW, Pennsylvania Ave WNW and ESE, K St ramps east and west. K St through lanes pass beneath in an underpass. George Washington statue in the central park.

water.canal_towpath_side: south (river side) of the canal throughout the box, between the canal and K St / Water St (all three sources agree)

canal_footbridges.name: Potomac St footbridge (pedestrian way south of M St)
Francis Scott Key Bridge (high-level crossing, no access)

areas.name: Surface parking under Whitehurst Freeway (Water St north side, 33rd-34th St)

landmarks.name: Key Bridge north landing
landmarks.notes: Key Bridge meets M St between 35th and 36th St; the Whitehurst Freeway ramp joins here (R1, R2, R3 geometry).

landmarks.name: Exorcist Steps
landmarks.notes: Steep public stair from M St up to Prospect St at 36th St (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Car Barn (old streetcar barn, 3600 M St)
landmarks.notes: North side of M St just west of the Exorcist Steps (R1, R2).

landmarks.name: Healy Hall, Georgetown University
landmarks.notes: Tall spired clock-tower hall, visible from the river (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Georgetown University main gate (37th & O)
landmarks.notes: Where O St ends at 37th St (R1, R2; R3 says O St ends at the gate).

landmarks.name: Holy Trinity Church
landmarks.notes: Near 36th and N St (R1, R3).

landmarks.name: Capital Crescent Trail start
landmarks.notes: West end of Water St (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Key Bridge Boathouse
landmarks.notes: Kayak and canoe rental under Key Bridge. Single source (R2).

landmarks.name: Potomac Boat Club
landmarks.notes: Rowing club on the river bank west of Key Bridge. Single source (R1).

landmarks.name: Washington Canoe Club
landmarks.notes: Historic canoe club on the river bank. Single source (R2).

landmarks.name: Waterfront Park fountain (foot of Wisconsin Ave)
landmarks.notes: Interactive fountain in Georgetown Waterfront Park (R1, R2).

landmarks.name: Washington Harbour
landmarks.notes: Riverside restaurants, boardwalk, boat slips, fountains; ice rink in winter (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Old Stone House (3051 M St)
landmarks.notes: North side of M St; oldest standing building in DC, small garden behind (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Georgetown Park (shopping mall)
landmarks.notes: Shops between M St and the canal at Wisconsin Ave (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Wisconsin Ave and M St
landmarks.notes: Heart of Georgetown shopping. Single source as a landmark (R2).

landmarks.name: Grace Episcopal Church
landmarks.notes: Wisconsin Ave between the canal and K St. Single source (R1).

landmarks.name: Ritz-Carlton Georgetown (old incinerator smokestack)
landmarks.notes: 3100 South St; the brick smokestack is a landmark (R1, R2).

landmarks.name: C&O Canal locks 3-4
landmarks.notes: In the canal by 30th St (R1, R2 median; R3 puts it at Thomas Jefferson St by the visitor centre). Water level steps down through Locks 1-4 toward Rock Creek.

landmarks.name: Four Seasons Hotel (2800 Pennsylvania Ave)
landmarks.notes: South side of Pennsylvania Ave by the Rock Creek bridges (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Thompson Boat Center
landmarks.notes: Boat, kayak and bike rental at the mouth of Rock Creek (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Tudor Place
landmarks.notes: Mansion and garden between Q and R St off 31st St (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Dumbarton Oaks
landmarks.notes: House and museum on R St; gardens extend north of the box (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Oak Hill Cemetery gate (3001 R St)
landmarks.notes: Gate on the north side of R St at 30th St (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Georgetown Library (Wisconsin Ave and R St)
landmarks.notes: Next to Book Hill park (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Washington Circle (George Washington statue)
landmarks.notes: Equestrian statue in the centre of the circle (all three sources).

landmarks.name: GWU Hospital
landmarks.notes: Just south of Washington Circle on 23rd St (all three sources).

landmarks.name: Foggy Bottom-GWU Metro
landmarks.notes: Station entrance at 23rd and I St. Single source (R1).

landmarks.name: Watergate complex
landmarks.notes: At the south edge of the box, west of New Hampshire Ave (R1, R3).

landmarks.name: Sheridan Circle
landmarks.notes: Just north-east of where 23rd St reaches Q St; its streets (Massachusetts Ave, R St east of the creek) are not modelled (R1, R2, both low confidence).

All three inputs are from memory, not surveys; expect 20-80 m absolute error. Consensus = per-station median of the sources (mean where only two cover), then intersections snapped (nodes within 15 m merged) so every junction is one shared coordinate.

Washington Circle: centre 38.90250,-77.05050, radius 55 m (sources 50-60 m). Spoke angles are derived from the consensus streets, not from any single source. K St through lanes use an underpass (R1, R3; R2 "believed"); R2 joins K St to the ring, so both a tunnel segment and two short ramps are modelled. The tunnel crosses the ring in plan without a shared node.

Whitehurst Freeway: elevated over K St / Water St, so its centreline passes within a few metres of at-grade nodes (e.g. Wisconsin Ave / K St at 38.9029,-77.0625). Do not snap it to the street graph except at its two endpoints (M St / Key Bridge node and the east end of the K St bridge). Its real ramps to Canal Rd and Rock Creek Pkwy are not modelled.

Rock Creek and Potomac Parkway has no junctions inside the box (it passes under all five bridges); in reality ramps connect it to K St / Virginia Ave near Thompson Boat Center. Canal Rd and the parkway also run reversible one-way at rush hour; modelled two-way.

Bridge ends over Rock Creek were extended where needed so each bridge clears both the creek and the parkway by about 18 m (consensus creek and parkway crossings: M St creek -77.05603 / parkway -77.05545, Pennsylvania Ave creek -77.05631 / parkway -77.05566, P St creek -77.05415 / parkway -77.05355, Q St creek -77.05355 / parkway -77.05285, K St creek -77.05750 / parkway -77.05670).
